blocks.text: Grade 11 高频词汇 101–200
plenitude /'plenitjuːd/ n. 充分, 完全, 丰富, 大量, 充足
into the plenitude and vacuity,
中文语境：进入充实与空虚， 【08】进寺庙。 【09】振兴棺材制造者
respite /'respait/ n. 暂缓, 缓期执行；v.t. 使暂缓
was the cruelest respite;
中文语境：是最残酷的喘息；
repetition /.repi'tiʃən/ n. 重复, 背诵, 循环, 复制品, 副本；[机] 重复, 反复
Rote not ritual, a repetition
中文语境：死记硬背不是仪式，是重复
ritual /'ritʃuəl/ n. 仪式, 典礼, 宗教仪式；adj. 仪式的, 依仪式进行的
Rote not ritual, a repetition
中文语境：死记硬背不是仪式，是重复
restorative /ri'stɒrətiv/ adj. 恢复健康的, 滋补的；n. 兴奋药, 补药
Time with your thoughts sans social distractions can also be restorative, build your confidence and make it easier for you to maintain boundaries, Ms.
中文语境：没有社交干扰的独处时间也可以让你恢复活力，建立你的信心，让你更容易保持界限，女士
self-conscious /'self'kɔnʃəs/ adj. 自觉的, 怕难为情的
It also helps us discover new interests and ideas without having to worry about the opinions of others - one study even showed that teens are less self-conscious when they're alone.
中文语境：它还可以帮助我们发现新的兴趣和想法，而不必担心他人的意见 - 一项研究甚至表明，青少年在独处时不那么难为情
aversion /ə'vəːʃən/ n. 厌恶, 讨厌的事, 讨厌的人；[医] 厌恶, 移转, 移位

Our aversion to being alone can be quite drastic: A quarter of the women and two-thirds of the men in a University of Virginia study chose to subject themselves to an electric shock rather than do nothing and spend time alone with their thoughts.
中文语境：我们对独处的厌恶可能非常强烈：在弗吉尼亚大学的一项研究中，四分之一的女性和三分之二的男性选择让自己遭受电击，而不是什么都不做，花时间独处思考
canyon /'kænjən/ n. 峡谷, 海底悬崖
in the canyon darkness,
中文语境：峡谷黑暗中，
spin /spin/ n. 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰, 情绪低落；v.t. 纺织, 纺, 使旋转, 编造；v.i. 纺纱, 吐丝, 作茧, 结网, 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰
I lean upon spins me
中文语境：我靠着旋转着我
presence /'prezns/ n. 出席, 面前, 存在, 仪态, 风度；[电] 出现
a massive presence
中文语境：大量存在
heretofore /.hiətu'fɒː/ adv. 直到此时, 此时以前, 迄今

This involves an absolute equality of personal rights and rights of property between former masters and slaves, and the connection heretofore existing between them becomes that between employer and hired labor.
中文语境：这涉及到前主人和奴隶之间的人身权和财产权的绝对平等，而他们之间迄今为止存在的联系成为雇主和雇佣劳工之间的联系
obscurity /əb'skjuəriti/ n. 阴暗, 朦胧, 晦涩, 费解, 身份低微
A moment free from distractions, obscurity, and conflict.
中文语境：一个没有干扰、默默无闻和冲突的时刻
reluctance /ri'lʌktəns/ n. 不情愿, 勉强；[电] 磁阻
3 was met with reluctance, most slaveholders began to release their former slaves during the latter part of 1865.
中文语境：3 由于不情愿，大多数奴隶主在 1865 年下半年开始释放他们以前的奴隶
endow /in'dau/ v.t. 捐赠, 捐助, 赋予；[法] 赠送财产给, 分给寡妇一份遗产, 授与
Nature, having endowed them equally, leaves them to their own skill and judgment in the hour of danger, and, if not equal to the occasion, alike they perish.
中文语境：大自然平等地赋予了他们，在危险时刻让他们依靠自己的技能和判断力，如果不适合时机，他们同样会灭亡
consensus /kən'sensəs/ n. 合意, 一致, 同感；[计] 合意
Again, we ask complete individual development for the general good; for the consensus of the competent on the whole round of human interests, on all questions of national life.
中文语境：再次，我们要求个人的全面发展是为了公共利益；为了主管人员就人类整体利益、国家生活的所有问题达成共识
milieu /'miːljəː/ n. 周围, 社会环境, 环境, 表达的手法；[医] 环境

This speculation is supported by the theory that bullying is a learned behavior, and that as they enter middle school, sixth-graders have not yet learned how to interact positively in the social milieu of the school.
中文语境：这种推测得到了以下理论的支持：欺凌是一种习得行为，当六年级学生进入中学时，他们还没有学会如何在学校的社交环境中积极互动
determinant /di'təːminənt/ n. 决定物, 决定因素；adj. 决定性的；[计] 判定
Research indicates, for example, that toughness and aggressiveness are important status considerations for boys, while appearance is a central determinant of social status among girls (Eder, 1995).
中文语境：例如，研究表明，坚韧和攻击性是男孩重要的地位考虑因素，而外表是女孩社会地位的核心决定因素（Eder，1995）
contend /kən'tend/ v.i. 奋斗, 斗争, 竞争；v.t. 为...斗争

These authors contend that bullying can best be understood from a social-interactional perspective (i.e., bullying behaviors are considered a result of a complex interaction between individual characteristics, such as impulsivity, and the social context, including the peer group and school social system).
中文语境：这些作者认为，最好从社会互动的角度来理解欺凌行为（即，欺凌行为被认为是个人特征（例如冲动）与社会背景（包括同伴群体和学校社会系统）之间复杂相互作用的结果
progeny /'prɒdʒəni/ n. 子孙, 后裔, 成果；[医] 后代, 后裔

"Books are not absolutely dead things, but do contain a potency of life in them as to be as active as that soul was whose progeny they are," wrote John Milton, author of Paradise Lost , in his 1644 book Areopagitica .
中文语境：《失乐园》的作者约翰·弥尔顿在他 1644 年出版的《Areopagitica》一书中写道："书籍并不是绝对死的东西，但它们确实蕴含着一种生命的力量，就像它们的后代的灵魂一样活跃。"
arson /'ɑːsən/ n. 纵火, 纵火罪；[法] 纵火, 放火
Qin was only one in a long line of ancient rulers who felt threatened enough by the ideas expressed in written form to advocate arson.
中文语境：秦国只是一长串古代统治者中的一个，他们对书面形式表达的思想感到足够的威胁，提倡纵火
heretic /'herətik/ n. 异教徒, 异端者
Hillerbrand writes that the executioner charged with killing heretics like Bruno and Hus was often the same person who put flame to their books.
中文语境：希勒布兰德写道，被指控杀害布鲁诺和胡斯等异端分子的刽子手往往是焚烧他们书籍的同一个人
boundless /'baundlis/ adj. 无限的, 无边无际的；[经] 无限的
Of that colossal wreck, boundless and bare
中文语境：那巨大的残骸，无边无际，光秃秃的
sculptor /'skʌlptə/ n. 雕刻家
Tell that its sculptor well those passions read
中文语境：告诉它的雕塑家很好地阅读了那些激情
colossal /kə'lɒsəl/ adj. 巨大的, 巨像似的
Of that colossal wreck, boundless and bare
中文语境：那巨大的残骸，无边无际，光秃秃的
shatter /'ʃætə/ n. 碎片, 粉碎, 落叶, 喷洒；v.t. 打碎, 使散开, 粉碎, 破坏；v.i. 粉碎, 损坏, 脱落
Half sunk, a shattered visage lies, whose frown,
中文语境：半沉下去，一张破碎的脸躺在那里，他皱着眉头，
decay /di'kei/ n. 衰退, 腐败；v. (使)衰退, (使)腐败
Round the decay
中文语境：圆衰变
survive /sə'vaiv/ v.t. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于；v.i. 活下来, 幸存
Which yet survive, stamped on these lifeless things,
中文语境：仍然存在，铭刻在这些无生命的事物上，
sideshow /'saidʃəu/ n. 杂耍, 附属活动, 枝节问题
Instead of a sideshow to actual legal proceedings, it is turning into an alternative system of dispute resolution and justice.
中文语境：它不再是实际法律程序的旁白，而是正在转变为一种替代性的争议解决和司法系统
augment /ɒːg'ment/ v. 增加, 增长；[计] 增加; 增量; 添加
More and more individuals - and companies - are augmenting, even bypassing entirely, traditional legal process hoping to get a more favorable hearing in public.
中文语境：越来越多的个人和公司正在扩大甚至完全绕过传统的法律程序，希望在公开场合获得更有利的听证会
languish /'læŋgwiʃ/ v.i. 憔悴, 凋萎, 苦思
And while it's still a surprise when some cases go viral while others languish in obscurity, it's simply more effective to present your case on Facebook or Twitter.
中文语境：虽然有些案例像病毒一样传播而另一些案例却默默无闻，这仍然令人惊讶，但在 Facebook 或 Twitter 上展示您的案例会更有效
firm /fəːm/ n. 公司, 商号；adj. 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的；v.t. 使牢固, 使坚定；v.i. 变稳固, 变坚实；adv. 稳固地
They've hired firms to monitor Facebook, Twitter, and other internet venues where these battles originate.
中文语境：他们聘请了公司来监控 Facebook、Twitter 和其他引发这些战斗的互联网场所
pillage /'pilidʒ/ n. 掠夺, 抢劫, 掠夺物, 战利品；v. 掠夺, 抢劫
My cholesterol skyrocketed as I pillaged food deserts for cheap sustenance.
中文语境：当我为了廉价的食物而掠夺食物沙漠时，我的胆固醇飙升
collateral /kə'lætərəl/ adj. 并行的, 附随的, 旁系的；n. 旁系亲属, 担保品
It's time we do more to help the collateral victims of mass imprisonment.
中文语境：现在是我们采取更多行动来帮助大规模监禁的附带受害者的时候了
asthma /'æsmə/ n. 哮喘；[医] 气喘
It is a "silent American epidemic" more common than childhood asthma (5.3 million vs.
中文语境：这是一种比儿童哮喘更常见的"无声的美国流行病"（530 万人对 200 万人）
prioritize /'praiəritaiz/ v.t. 按优先次序列出, 优先考虑
Sentencing alternatives should be prioritized in the absence of confounding factors.
中文语境：在没有混杂因素的情况下，应优先考虑量刑替代方案
acclimate /ə'klaimit/ v.t. 使适应, 使服水土；v.i. 服水土, 适应新环境
I had become acclimated to shorter distances," he said, attributing this change to the shrinkage of his hippocampus, "I cannot, even to this day, acclimate myself to broader distance.
中文语境：我已经习惯了较短的距离，"他说，并将这种变化归因于他的海马体的缩小，"即使到今天，我也无法让自己适应更远的距离
defecate /'defikeit/ v.t. 除去污物, 澄清, 净化；v.i. 澄清, 排便
In this environment, you sleep, you eat, you defecate, you live all of your life," Haney said.
中文语境：在这种环境中，你睡觉、吃饭、排便，你一生都在生活，"哈尼说
hallucination /hə.luːsi'neiʃən/ n. 幻觉, 幻想；[医] 幻觉

A majority of those surveyed experienced symptoms such as dizziness, heart palpitations, chronic depression, while 41 percent reported hallucinations, and 27 percent had suicidal thoughts - all levels significantly higher than those of the overall prison populations.
中文语境：大多数接受调查的人都经历过头晕、心悸、慢性抑郁等症状，41% 的人报告出现幻觉，27% 的人有自杀念头--所有水平都显着高于监狱总体人口的水平
devoid /di'vɒid/ adj. 全无的, 缺乏的

Most prisoners spent at least 23 hours per day in this environment, devoid of stimuli (some are allowed in a yard or indoor area for an hour or less daily), and are denied physical contact on visits from friends and family, so they may go years or decades without touching another human, apart from when they're placed in physical restraints by guards.
中文语境：大多数囚犯每天在这种没有刺激的环境中度过至少 23 个小时（有些囚犯每天被允许在院子或室内区域呆一个小时或更短时间），并且在朋友和家人探访时被禁止进行身体接触，因此他们可能数年或数十年都没有接触过其他人，除非他们被看守进行身体限制
insightful /'in.saitful/ adj. 有深刻见解的, 富有洞察力的
What if we thought of fear as an amazing act of the imagination, something that can be as profound and insightful as storytelling itself?
中文语境：如果我们认为恐惧是一种令人惊叹的想象力行为，可以像讲故事本身一样深刻和富有洞察力，结果会怎样呢？
lurid /'luərid/ adj. 火烧似的, 苍白的, 华丽的, 可怕的
Of all the narratives their fears wrote, they responded only to the most lurid, the most vivid, the one that was easiest for their imaginations to picture: cannibals.
中文语境：在他们的恐惧写下的所有叙述中，他们只对最耸人听闻、最生动、最容易用他们的想象力描绘的叙述做出回应：食人者
suspense /sə'spens/ n. 悬疑, 焦虑, 悬念, 悬而不决；[经] 未定, 暂记
Fears also have suspense.
中文语境：恐惧也有悬念
muddle /'mʌdl/ v.t. 混合, 使微醉, 使咬字不清晰；v.i. 胡乱对付；n. 困惑, 混浊状态
Do you want to go to doing different from what's in the books, and get things all muddled up?"
中文语境：你想去做与书本上不同的事情，把事情搞得一团糟吗？"
strangulation /.stræŋgju'leiʃən/ n. 勒杀, 绞死, 压缩；[医] 绞窄; 勒颈, 勒颈窒息
There was no additional strangulation; the noose about his neck was already suffocating him and kept the water from his lungs.
中文语境：没有发生额外的勒杀事件；他脖子上的绞索已经让他窒息，并阻止了他肺部的水分
obstreperous /əb'strepərəs/ adj. 吵闹的, 喧嚣的, 骚乱的, 不守秩序的
His head, pillowed on a thwart, was within an inch of the swirl of a wave crest, and sometimes a particularly obstreperous sea came in-board and drenched him once more.
中文语境：他的头枕在横座上，距离波峰的漩涡只有一英寸，有时，特别凶猛的海水会冲上船，再次把他淋湿
fragmentary /'fræ^məntəri/ adj. 碎片的, 碎屑的, 片断的, 断片的, 碎块的, 不完全的, 不连续的, 不完整的
The cook's arm was around the oiler's shoulders, and, with their fragmentary clothing and haggard faces, they were the babes of the sea, a grotesque rendering of the old babes in the wood.
中文语境：厨师的手臂搂着加油工的肩膀，她们衣衫褴褛，面容憔悴，就像是海里的宝贝，是树林里的老宝贝的怪诞翻版
protract /prəu'trækt/ v.t. 延长, 拖延, 伸出, 绘制；[法] 延迟, 拖延, 延长

...imploring Thee for the refuge of the grave and denied it - for our sakes who adore Thee, Lord, blast their hopes, blight their lives, protract their bitter pilgrimage, make heavy their steps, water their way with their tears, stain the white snow with the blood of their wounded feet!
中文语境：...恳求你庇护坟墓，却拒绝了--主啊，为了我们这些崇拜你的人，粉碎他们的希望，毁掉他们的生命，延长他们痛苦的朝圣之旅，使他们的脚步沉重，用他们的泪水浇灌他们的道路，用他们受伤脚的血染红白雪！
contrite /'kɒntrait/ adj. 悔悟了的, 后悔的, 痛悔的
We ask it, in the spirit of love, of Him Who is the Source of Love, and Who is the ever-faithful refuge and friend of all that are sore beset and seek His aid with humble and contrite hearts.
中文语境：我们本着爱的精神向爱的源头祈求，他是所有遭受痛苦困扰并以谦卑和悔罪的心寻求他帮助的人永远忠实的避难所和朋友
seamy /'siːmi/ adj. 露出线缝的, 丑恶的

An aged stranger entered and moved with slow and noiseless step up the main aisle, his eyes fixed upon the minister, his long body clothed in a robe that reached to his feet, his head bare, his white hair descending in a frothy cataract to his shoulders, his seamy face unnaturally pale, pale even to ghastliness.
中文语境：一位上了年纪的陌生人进来了，他缓慢而无声地走上主过道，他的眼睛盯着牧师，他修长的身体穿着长及脚的长袍，他光着头，白发如泡沫般的瀑布般垂到肩膀上，他那张肮脏的脸苍白得不自然，苍白到可怕
rebuke /ri'bjuːk/ n. 指责, 谴责, 非难；v.t. 斥责, 指责, 制止
Let pride be taught by this rebuke,
中文语境：让这种责备教导我们骄傲，
behold /bi'həuld/ v.t. 看到, 注视；v.i. 看
Behold his funeral appears,
中文语境：看他的葬礼出现了，
conscience /'kɒnʃəns/ n. 良心；[法] 良心, 道德感, 正义感
'Twas time in conscience he should die
中文语境："从良心上看，他应该死"
contumely /'kɒntjuːmili/ n. 无礼, 傲慢, 侮辱
Th' oppressor's wrong, the proud man's contumely
中文语境：压迫者的错误，骄傲的人的侮辱
insolence /'insələns/ n. 傲慢, 无耻, 傲慢态度；[法] 无礼, 蛮横, 侮辱性言行
The insolence of office, and the spurns
中文语境：公职的无礼和蔑视
pang /pæŋ/ n. 剧痛, 悲痛, 苦闷；v.t. 使剧痛, 折磨
The pangs of despised love, the law's delay,
中文语境：被蔑视的爱情的痛苦，法律的迟延，
skinflint /'skinfliŋt/ n. 吝啬鬼

Competition obliges the humane employer to adopt the same methods as the skinflint, or go out of business, and, as a consequence, the lowest rate of compensation for which men will work is all that he will pay.
中文语境：竞争迫使仁慈的雇主采取与吝啬鬼相同的方法，否则就会破产，因此，男人愿意付出的最低报酬就是他所能支付的全部
zephyr /'zefə/ n. 西风, 和风, 徐风

It is true that philosophers and philanthropists have spoken in favor of the "man who worked," but their pleadings and writings had no more effect on the minds of the wealth-getters than has a zephyr on the Eiffel Tower.
中文语境：确实，哲学家和慈善家都曾说过支持"工作的人"，但他们的恳求和著作对财富获取者的心灵的影响并不比埃菲尔铁塔上的和风更大
grope /grəup/ v. 摸索；n. 摸索
The Bravest - grope a little -
中文语境：最勇敢的人 - 摸索一下 -
disclose /dis'kləuz/ v.t. 揭露, 透露；[法] 揭发, 揭露, 公开
When not a Moon disclose a sign -
中文语境：当不是月亮透露一个标志时 -
erect /i'rekt/ adj. 直立的, 竖立的, 笔直的；v.t. 使竖立, 使直立, 树立, 建立；v.i. 勃起
And meet the Road - erect -
中文语境：与路相遇--直立--
alter /'ɒːltə/ v. 改变
Either the Darkness alters -
中文语境：要么黑暗改变--
toy /tɒi/ n. 玩具, 小玩艺儿, 小型的东西, 消遣；adj. 供玩耍的, 作为玩具的；v.i. 玩弄, 戏弄, 调情
As she toyed with the keyboard, an error message popped up.
中文语境：当她摆弄键盘时，弹出了一条错误消息
willful /'wilful/ adj. 任性的, 故意的, 有意的
